name: timezoneConvert
description: Converts a moment in time between IANA time zones. Returns the same instant rendered in the target zone (ISO with offset).

name: dateDiff
description: Computes b - a in the requested unit (days|hours|minutes|seconds|milliseconds). Returns a number which may be fractional.

name: urlEncode
description: Percent-encodes a string for use in a URL component. Equivalent to encodeURIComponent.
code:
/**
 * Percent-encodes a string for safe use inside a URL component.
 *
 * Encodes every character that is not in the RFC 3986 "unreserved" set
 * (ALPHA / DIGIT / -._~). Spaces become %20 (NOT '+'); '&', '=', '?', '#'
 * and other reserved characters are all encoded.
 *
 * Pure ES2024 — uses the standard encodeURIComponent only.
 */

if (text == null) throw new Error('text required');
return encodeURIComponent(String(text));

name: dateMath
description: Adds (or subtracts) a duration to a date and returns the resulting ISO timestamp. Unit: years|months|weeks|days|hours|minutes|seconds|milliseconds.

name: parseDate
description: Parses a date/time string (ISO 8601 or RFC 2822) and returns its components plus epochMillis.

params.name: timeZone
params.description: IANA time zone to interpret the components in (default UTC)

name: cronNext
description: Computes the next datetime matching a standard 5-field cron expression (minute hour day month weekday). Supports * , - / and ? (treated as *). Returns ISO timestamp in UTC.

params.name: count
params.description: Number of next occurrences to return (default 1, max 100)

name: diffText
description: Returns a line-by-line diff between two texts. Each entry is {op, line} where op is one of '=' (unchanged), '-' (only in a), '+' (only in b).

name: sortLines
description: Sorts lines of text alphabetically. Supports reverse and case-insensitive options.

name: piiDetect
description: Scans text for personally identifiable information patterns (email, US SSN, US phone, credit card, IPv4). Returns an array of {type, masked, index}.

params.name: text
params.testValue: Contact alice@example.com or call 555-867-5309. SSN 123-45-6789, card 4111 1111 1111 1111.

name: regexExtract
description: Returns all regex matches in the input. With the 'g' flag every match is returned; without it the first match (with capture groups) is returned.

name: formatDate
description: Formats a date (ISO string or epoch ms) using a pattern with tokens yyyy/MM/dd HH:mm:ss SSS. Time zone aware.

name: stats
description: Returns summary statistics (count, sum, min, max, mean, median, stddev) for an array of numbers.

name: secretPatternDetect
description: Scans text for well-known secret patterns (AWS keys, GitHub tokens, Slack tokens, OpenAI keys, Stripe keys, private keys). Returns an array of {type, masked, index}.

name: regexReplace
description: Replaces regex matches in the input with the given replacement string. Supports $1, $2 group back-references.

name: evalExpression
description: Evaluates a safe arithmetic/logical expression (no eval, no host access). Supports + - * / % ** parens, &&, ||, !, ==, !=, <, <=, >, >=, and numeric/string/boolean literals plus variables from the variables object.

name: formatCsv
description: Serialises an array of rows into CSV text. Rows may be arrays (use header param) or objects (keys become the header). RFC 4180 quoting.
